_doc: fc-parallel-009 (time): list_calendar + schedule_meeting; no order. The prompt says 'check if 14:00 UTC is free, and if it is, schedule...' but the test passes either order: list-then-schedule (check first) or schedule-then-list (assume free, verify after). No order dependency; tests that the model picks the right 2 time tools out of 4 (cancel_meeting, get_current_time, list_calendar, schedule_meeting).
prompt: Check the calendar for 2026-12-01 to see if 14:00 UTC is free. If it is, schedule a 60-minute 'Team retro' with alice@example.com, bob@example.com, carol@example.com, and dave@example.com at that slot.

function.name: schedule_meeting
function.description: Schedule a calendar meeting. `attendees` is a list of email addresses, `date` is YYYY-MM-DD, `time` is HH:MM in 24h, `timezone` is an IANA tz like 'UTC', `duration_minutes` is an integer.

function.name: get_current_time
function.description: Return the current local time in the given IANA timezone.

function.name: cancel_meeting
function.description: Cancel a previously scheduled meeting by its id.

function.name: list_calendar
function.description: List meetings scheduled between two ISO datetimes.
